support.reason: Reproduced the abort on master `128456b62d` with three peers against a global limit of 2. The two halves of the fix depend on each other: with only the clamp and the old `>` filter, every peer sits at exactly its floored share, the heap comes out empty and the loop pops from it, which segfaults here. So `>=` is not cleanup. Full unit suite and `p2p_orphan_handling.py` pass on the merge.
